dct_description_sm: Defines a common format for public transportation and associated geographic information. The feed is composed of a series of text files that each models a particular aspect of transit information: stops, routes, trips, and other schedule data. It also includes the shape of the lines of the routes.
dct_rights_sm: Please refer to "York Region Open Data Licence", searchable on this website.
dct_title_s: YRT/VIVA Scheduled General Transit Feed Specification (GTFS) Data
